name: Advantech Co., Ltd.
description: Advantech Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacturing, and marketing of embedded computing boards, industrial automation products, and applied and industrial computers. The company operates through Intelligent Systems; Embedded Design-In; IoT Automation; Intelligent Service; and Advantech Service Plus and Others segments. It offers AIOT software, distribution, and services, application focus embedded, arm-based computing platforms, computer on modules, digital signage players, edge AI and intelligence solutions, embedded PCs and single board computers, fan less embedded computers, gaming platform solutions, industrial display systems, industrial flash and memory, industrial motherboards and wireless solutions, and wireless e-paper display solutions. The company also provides automation controllers and I/O, certified solutions, embedded automation computers, gateways and remote terminal units, human machine interfaces, certified, class I division 2 and ATEX, panel PCs, power and energy, and remote I/O and wireless sensing modules, as well as web access software and edge solution ready platform. In addition, it offers data acquisition, box and modular IPC, transportation systems, and rackmount IPC; and industrial computer peripherals, GPU, and motherboards and slot SBC. Further, the company provides intelligent connectivity solutions; cloud, networking, and servers solutions; intelligent healthcare, mobile solutions, logistics, city services, and retail solutions; and industrial mounting. It also offers, edge computing and WISE-edge, embedded solutions and design-in, energy and utilities, iFactory, iHealthcare, industrial and edge servers, industrial equipment builder, intelligent transport, iRetail and iCity services; and design and manufacturing, industrial display, gaming, iLogistics, video solutions, and IoT edge intelligence solutions and services. Advantech Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
